text:
elaine: Starting a thread for release notes + migration guide for embeddings streaming removal. Draft PR up at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523. Main asks: clear migration steps, small SDK snippet sweep, and a concise known-issues list for customers.

peter: Taking JS/TS. Note: alpha client uses `embeddings.embed` while stable uses `embeddings.create`. I'll include both with a version note.

jun: I'll own Ruby and PHP snippets. Also recommend an FAQ entry about re-associating batched responses (use `id` fields) and a tiny troubleshooting example.

ops-bot: link-checker: 1 broken anchor found (/docs/embeds#streaming). Suggested replacement: /reference/embeddings#migration. Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/linkcheck/4523

elaine: Thanks, pushed a redirects commit to the PR branch to fix that anchor and updated the PR description. Also added a YAML example for routing policy opt-out to the relnotes:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  preference: latency
  fallback: cost_variant
```

peter: Quick wording tweak for the relnotes paragraph: "Hosted default routing now favors latency; teams can configure per-route `routing_policy` to opt into cost-first behavior. See migration guide for examples and known issues." I'll push that small edit.

docs-bot: deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-4523--docs.redwood.ai/ (preview expires in 7 days)

jun: Pushed Ruby and PHP examples and added the FAQ snippet about `id` fields for batching. Marked SDK snippets done in the PR checklist.

elaine: Visual QA scheduled for 15:30 PT. If no regressions, plan to merge at 16:00 PT and publish a short announce blurb. Draft announce blurb: "Docs: embeddings migration guide + updated SDK snippets. Read the migration steps before upgrading clients."

peter: LGTM. I'll watch the preview for layout regressions.

elaine: Thanks everyone — ping #docs when ready for post-merge publish.
